about: An existing codebase with CI policy checks, worked through as 8 tickets by unattended sessions. Each fresh session rediscovers the policies by breaking them, unless something tells it.
sessions: You are working through the shop's backlog on your own: nobody will answer questions, so make reasonable choices and finish the ticket. Ticket #1: add `remove_item(name, qty)` to the inventory, which takes units out of stock and raises ValueError if there aren't enough (or qty isn't positive). Export it from the `shop` package. Run ./ci.sh before you finish.

You are working through the shop's backlog on your own: nobody will answer questions, so make reasonable choices and finish the ticket. Export it from `shop`. Run ./ci.sh before you finish.

Export it from `shop`. Run ./ci.sh before you finish.
